dispersed.U_rule: uniform without replacement within mask, all768 eligible, H/L overlap allowed; same U across definitions
dispersed.matching: exclude reference H/L set; exact joint stratum quota; no contact-label matching; ascending position candidate order
dispersed.insufficiency: Any insufficient stratum: whole matching strategy for that definition/ratio NA; retain quotas/counts. No borrowing, replacement, reference overlap relaxation, changed k or case substitution.
dispersed.finite_space: Distinct masks only. If feasible space N<20, enumerate lexicographically all N. Otherwise sample20 distinct uniformly from product of per-stratum combinations; duplicate proposals are not new repeats. At10000 proposals stop with partial count/reason; no new root or rule changes.

windows.attribution: mean original summary across window; high/low chosen before any perturbed score, ties lower start
windows.uniform: 20 distinct grid windows per width, both definitions share U_window
windows.matched: exclude exact reference window; exact construct-marker occupancy vector + center_block128 + center distance to nearest MODEL endpoint bin; overlap allowed and reported; no contact information
windows.insufficiency: If candidates<20 use all; zero=NA. No alternate grid/strata/width. Window roles reference already scanned score; zero additional inference.
windows.dependence: Overlapping windows correlated; no window-as-independent-n inference
